description: Plan a safe file or export rename from a caller-supplied module graph: every module that references the target, the reference kinds, indirect references through the graph, a safe edit order, and risk flags. Returns the plan only; nothing is read, renamed, or executed.

dynamic_imports.description: Module paths this module imports dynamically

names.description: Named bindings imported from the module; absent means the module is imported with no named bindings (optional)

target.description: The file or export to rename

kind.description: Whether the target is a file or an export

module.description: Module defining the export (required for kind export)

name.description: For kind file: the module path. For kind export: the export name

name: plan_rename
